classification_policy: SF2 remains SF2_ACQUISITION_FAIL. SF3 is classified only by the frozen gates below.
hypothesis: SF2 acquired nearly all training-family factual selections while retaining language and binding, but its Alex/Owen decision boundary continued sweeping toward Owen under a constant late English learning rate. Linearly annealing only the late English-update learning rate may let the conditional boundary settle without the one-item overshoot.
manipulated_variable: English-update learning rate after global update 100 only

sf2_update100.role: hard deterministic replay control; all model tensors must match exactly at update 100 before the SF3 schedule diverges

schedule.cadence: 20 cycles of 9 English updates followed by 1 binding update
schedule.english_batch: all 16 TRAIN records twice, exactly as materialized

learning_rate.updates_1_through_100: 5e-5 for English and binding, identical to SF2
learning_rate.updates_101_through_200_english: For the post-100 English ordinal j=1..90, lr(j)=5e-5*(90-j)/89; first is 5e-5 and last is 0.
learning_rate.justification: Linear-to-zero introduces no arbitrary floor or curve parameter, halves late cumulative English step size, and directly tests the constant-rate boundary-overshoot hypothesis. Binding pressure is held fixed.

optimizer: One fresh AdamW from Pilot1: betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.05, amsgrad=False, foreach=False, fused=False; continuous state for 200 updates; no scheduler object; global gradient clip 2.0 over gradient-bearing parameters.
optimizer_state_policy: Updates 1-100 are deterministically replayed from the untouched parent. Update-100 model tensors must exactly equal preserved SF2 update100; optimizer state is the deterministic state produced by that replay. No model-only checkpoint branching or optimizer reset is permitted.
scope: Identical to SF2/SF1: English trains token and position embeddings, blocks 4-7, final norm, and untied language head; blocks 0-3 and all T13 localizer/retrieval parameters frozen. Binding updates restore the established full T13 trainable scope.

objectives.english: Identical to SF2: correctly aligned mean full-vocabulary causal CE on four answer tokens plus final EOS, plus lambda=1.0 forward KL D_KL(P_student||P_Pilot1) over 160 frozen ordinary-language positions per English update.
objectives.binding: Identical pinned T13 answer causal CE plus hard-min permutation-invariant localization objective with authoritative weight/reduction.

kl.teacher: separate frozen Pilot1 ordinary base model, no shared storage, no optimizer membership

evaluation.update_0: acquisition, aligned TinyStories DEV, both nonsacred binding pools separately, D3
evaluation.update_100: full frozen checks plus exact SF2 update100 tensor-reproduction gate
evaluation.updates_125_150_175: TRAIN acquisition panel only; descriptive boundary trajectory; never used to tune or stop
evaluation.update_200: full frozen checks and fixed endpoint classification
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: fixed update 200 only; no best checkpoint selection

gates.acquisition: correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND complete_families==4
gates.language: aligned TinyStories DEV CE <= update0 CE + 0.25 at updates 100 and 200
gates.binding: on each nonsacred 80-item pool independently: answer>=76, BOTH_DISTINCT>=76, collapse==0 at updates 100 and 200
gates.d3: mean combined Alex/Owen/Mia/Nora probability mass <=0.01 at updates 100 and 200
gates.update100_replay: all update100 model tensors exactly equal the preserved SF2 update100 tensors; any mismatch is a hard stop before annealing

transfer_lock: HELDOUT16, ALTERNATE48, COPY8, and COMPETING64 remain unopened unless and until update200 acquisition, language, binding, and D3 gates all pass. If opened, they are descriptive diagnostics only. FINAL and sacred material are never accessed.
stopping: Stop on any baseline/hash/provenance/determinism failure; update100 replay mismatch; language, binding, or D3 safety failure; update100 acquisition guard; or fixed endpoint completion. Do not adapt treatment after observations.
persistence: Atomic rolling restart after every committed update with model, optimizer, RNG, scope, and provenance; permanent checkpoints/evaluation artifacts at all preregistered evaluation points; resume only the latest valid committed state and never replay a committed update.
